chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: حَمْدَوَيْهُ بْنُ نَصِيرٍ، عَنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْخَطَّابِ، عَنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ، عَنِ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh ibn Nusayr, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub who said:

chunks.arabic_text: دَخَلَ عِيسَى بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْقُمِّيُّ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَأَوْصَاهُ بِأَشْيَاءَ ثُمَّ وَدَّعَهُ وَخَرَجَ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ لِخَادِمِهِ: ادْعُهُ، فَانْصَرَفَ إِلَيْهِ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِ، فَأَوْصَاهُ بِأَشْيَاءَ ثُمَّ وَدَّعَهُ وَخَرَجَ عَنْهُ، فَقَالَ لِخَادِمِهِ: ادْعُهُ، فَانْصَرَفَ إِلَيْهِ فَأَوْصَاهُ بِأَشْيَاءَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ: يَا عِيسَى بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَقُولُ: ﴿وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِالصَّلَاةِ﴾، وَإِنَّكَ مِنَّا أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ، فَإِذَا كَانَتِ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ هَاهُنَا مِقْدَارُهَا مِنْ هَاهُنَا مِنَ الْعَصْرِ، فَصَلِّ سِتَّ رَكَعَاتٍ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ وَدَّعَهُ وَقَبَّلَ مَا بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْ عِيسَى فَانْصَرَفَ

translations.en: Isa ibn Abdallah al-Qummi entered to see Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who exhorted him about certain things, then bid him farewell and he left. The Imam said to his servant: 'Call him back.' So the servant went out to him and he returned. The Imam again exhorted him about certain things, then bid him farewell and he left. The Imam said to his servant for the second time: 'Call him back.' So the servant went out to him and [when he returned] the Imam exhorted him about certain other things. Then he said to him: 'O Isa ibn Abdallah, indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: "And enjoin prayer upon your family," and you are from us, the People of the House. So when the sun is on this side [west], and its distance is this much from that point in the afternoon, then pray six units [of prayer].' He [Yunus] said: Then he bid him farewell and kissed the spot between Isa's eyes before he departed.

en.summary: This narration from Rijal al-Kashshi highlights the spiritual intimacy between Imam al-Sadiq (AS) and Isa ibn Abdallah al-Qummi, marked by repeated private instructions and a final blessing. The Imam prescribes six units of voluntary prayer at the precise moment of Asr, grounding this specific devotional act in the Quranic command to 'enjoin your family to prayer' (20:132) while affirming Isa's lineage within the Ahl al-Bayt. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on consistent, time-specific voluntary prayers as a means of maintaining spiritual connection with the Imams.
en.seo_question: What is the ruling and significance of the six-unit afternoon prayer mentioned in the hadith of Isa ibn Abdallah?

key_terms.عِنْدَ الْعَصْرِ: At the time of Asr (afternoon prayer time)
